title: Could I get some critique on my block snake games?
author: Pitiful_Will_6449
selftext:
Backstory: my nephews play these snake games and are subjected to ads that bothered me, so I set out to build my own flavors of the games they played. I have a background in writing MUDs back in the early 2000s so I added some NPCs and zone bosses to the corners.  

But I have limited 2D/graphics experience. I build rust tokio async 100+ player text games.  So this was a little out of my comfort zone.  Any improvements or suggestions I will research and consider! 

[BYTE](https://byte.gorged.io/play/)

There are two games in this suite. The kids liked the numbers brain rot version, and my wife likes the word tile version (lol)
